text: Performance evidence: the exact same 52,416-feature workload fell from 3,476.43 s to 123.498 s after removing repeated global validation from trusted node access, a 28.1x end-to-end improvement; local evaluation fell from 3,417.17 s to 57.790 s, a 59.1x improvement. This validates the constitutional rule that the compiler validates once and kernels receive canonical trusted objects. The estimand, numerical reduction, covariance recipe, and solve were unchanged and oracle suites remained green.
